panels.description: Colorado CSG facility: Roman sits with hospital schedule, unapproved T-ALL chemistry file, and months-scale deterioration marker; his bonded TJ stands beside them. Leave upper area clear.
Croft places his medical-alert bracelet beside the file without touching Roman. Leave upper third for dialogue.
Croft turns the treatment schedule toward Roman’s tense face. Leave upper third for dialogue.
Roman signs a restricted-access form; bonded TJ display reads LOCAL PARTITION: STATUS PULSE. His hand remains on the pen. Leave lower-right for dialogue.

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: The approved route is too slow.

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: By the time it is approved, there may be no patient left to approve it for.

items.speaker: ROMAN
items.text: I’ll run the chemistry. I keep the records.
